contran_945.message: Ropes are prohibited as cargo lashing; use straps or chains.
The lashings' working capacity is less than twice the weight they hold.
Each unit needs at least 4 lashing terminals hooked to the truck.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
The load does not fill the body length: close the gaps or add diagonal lashings against forward and backward movement.
This body has no containment panels: every unit needs diagonal lashings against forward and backward movement, even with no gap.
No cargo uses an open body's headboard as a stop.
Cargo above the headboard could slide forward over it.

securing.message: Ropes are prohibited as cargo lashing; use straps or chains.

Every article has the tiedowns 393.110 asks for its length and weight.
No cargo is in contact with the front end structure.
Applies to cargo inside a van's walls.
No article on the deck is likely to roll.
No metal coils of 5,000 lb or more.
No machinery of 10,000 lb or more.
Tiedowns are hooked to the truck's anchor points.
Ropes are allowed without knots and if the driver can re-tighten them.
